The AI Word List

The words that make people reply, call, or buy, and where to put them

Most posts and DMs fail on word choice, not on the offer. A few small words make it easy for someone to say yes. A few others make them feel sold to.

This list gives you words that work, grouped by the job they do, with weak versus stronger examples. Copy them into posts, DMs, subject lines, and sales pages.

One rule goes with all of it: only use a word if it's true. Urgency you invent and promises you can't keep cost you more than they earn.

1. Words that get a reply

Use in the first line of a DM or comment. They keep the pressure low and make answering easy.

quick questioncuriousmind if I askhonest questionrandom thoughtsaw your postout of curiositywould it help if

WeakHi, I help people grow their business. Interested?
StrongerQuick question. Saw your post about your first launch. What's been the hardest part so far?

2. Words that make the promise specific

Use in headlines and the first line of a post. Specific beats impressive.

exactlystep by stepin 7 daysin one afternoonwithouteven ifthe onlyhow to

WeakLearn to make money online.
StrongerHow to get your first $50 sale in 7 days, even if you have no list.

3. Words that lower the risk

Use near the button, the price, and the ask. They answer the fear of getting it wrong.

freeno card neededcancel anytimetry itkeep it either wayguaranteesimpletakes 5 minutes

WeakSign up now for access.
StrongerGrab it free. No card needed. Keep it either way.

4. Words that create real urgency

Use only when there is a true deadline or limit. Name the date or the number.

todayby Fridayuntil midnightonly 20 spotscloseslast daythis weekbefore

WeakHurry! Don't miss out on this amazing deal!
StrongerPrice goes up Friday at midnight. After that it's $27.

5. Words that say "this is for you"

Use at the top of a post or page. People act when they see themselves in it.

if you'reforbeginnersfirst salesolostarting from zerono experiencebusy

WeakA powerful system for everyone.
StrongerFor solo beginners with $0 and no list who want a first sale.

6. Words that show proof

Use right after a claim. A claim with a reason beats a claim alone.

becausehere's the proofI testedscreenshotresultsafterwhat happenedthe numbers

WeakThis method really works.
StrongerI tested it for 14 days. Here's what happened, with the screenshots.

7. Words that name the pain

Use in the opening of a post, an email, or a sales page. Describe the problem before you sell the fix.

stucktired ofstillkeepwastingnothing worksno one repliesbehind

WeakStruggling with online marketing?
StrongerPosting every day and still getting zero replies?

8. Words that ask for the action

Use in the last line. Tell people the one thing to do and make it small.

replysend mecommentDM megrabtapwatchtell me

WeakLet me know if you'd like to learn more.
StrongerReply with the word LIST and I'll send it over.

Words to cut

These words make your writing sound weak, vague, or like an ad. Search your draft for them and delete or replace.

  • just: It apologizes. "Just checking in" becomes "Checking in".
  • maybe / try to / I think: Hedging makes people trust you less. Commit or say why you're unsure.
  • solutions / synergy / best-in-class: Nobody talks like this. Name the thing you do.
  • unlock / elevate / game-changer: Hype words with no detail. Say what changes.
  • amazing / incredible / revolutionary: Adjectives you give yourself don't count. Show a result.
  • click here: Say what they get. "Get the checklist" beats "Click here".

Where to put the words

First line of a postGroups 5, 7, and 2. Make the reader feel seen or promise something specific.
First line of a DMGroup 1. Keep it low pressure and about them.
Right after a claimGroup 6. Back up every big claim with a reason or a result.
Near the button or priceGroup 3. Answer the fear of getting it wrong.
Final lineGroup 8, plus a true Group 4 if there's a real deadline.
Subject linesGroups 1 and 2. Short, specific, and curious. Under 50 characters.

Copy and paste this into any AI

Rewrite the text below. Use plain words. Cut these words: just, maybe, leverage, unlock, elevate, game-changer, amazing. Start with the reader's problem in one line. Make the promise specific with a number or a time frame. Add one reason it works. End with one small action. Keep my voice. Text: [paste your draft here]

Start with one group. Rewrite one post or DM using it today. Then check what changes in your replies.
